The reported X1 Carbon cat print on 2026-09-18 used SAAM G-code inside the reference package. The exporter's complete archive subsequently loaded but had not itself been printed in the recorded evidence.

The X1 Carbon accepted the complete exported archive with a warning that manual AMS tray mapping was unavailable; automatic colour-matched spool selection and starting remained available. The missing package fact was not identified.
One successful H2D left-nozzle PLA print with corrected relative-extrusion output was user-reported on 2026-09-18. This does not establish all nozzle sizes, AMS selections or firmware behavior.

The recorded S5 startup reports are installation- and export-specific; absence of explicit leveling commands did not prevent reported automatic firmware leveling and does not establish a supported per-file bypass.

Bambu documents H2D capacity of four AMS 2 Pro and eight AMS HT units, 24 slots in total; this does not establish physical routing by SAAM.
The AMS HT FAQ specifies up to four HT connections on X1/P1. SAAM retains a conservative four-device combined X1 limit; larger mixed topologies are unverified.
Studio serializes per-extruder AMS counts as sorted integer-key # count pairs separated by vertical bars. Supplied H2D archives show 1#0|4#1 for its right four-slot unit.

Studio reorders first-filament arrays using physical_extruder_map before expanding startup templates. H2D M620.17 T0/T1 therefore use physical-extruder order, not nozzle-group order; the installed template falls back to logical filament 0 for unused nozzles.

X1 single-nozzle PLA cutter/load/chute/wipe commands were cross-referenced to the installed X1 0.4 change-filament template dated 20251031. The SAAM 300 mm3 flush policy and physical execution remain unvalidated.

Studio's desktop ConfigBase G-code loader requires a BambuStudio comment prefix and at least 80 recognized configuration pairs. This desktop-reader requirement does not establish printer firmware behavior.
Studio's desktop GCodeProcessor loads embedded configuration only for recognized producer paths; consistent SAAM config fields alone do not establish their ingestion by Studio or the printer.
